d: Short, spiky charcoal-grey hair with jagged bangs and a single stray strand curving upward, framing a youthful face with wide, bright turquoise eyes. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a white sailor-style top with a navy blue collar, a red ribbon tied at the chest, and a short pleated navy blue skirt with white piping. Heavy grey metallic ship rigging is equipped on the back and arms, featuring large cannons, mechanical plating, and grey armored bands around the legs.
